title: Review Authority and Tier Movement in the Wanderlane Traveller Club
content:
A Wanderlane Traveller Club tier is moved only when the programme office has already recorded an approved review against this membership. The authority for a tier move is that record and nothing else: what the member states about their own qualifying record is not the authority, and a review that stands as submitted, in review, declined or withdrawn does not carry one either.

The review that authorises a move is a review recorded against this same membership, identified by its own review reference, and that reference is the one carried into the move. A review recorded against another membership, or a review whose decision is still to come, does not authorise a move on this card.

Where the review is failed, the tier drops at the end of the grace months of the tier held, and a tier with soft landing drops only one step however far short the member fell.

## The authority condition, set out as a test

| What the records show | Whether a tier may be moved |
| --- | --- |
| An approved review recorded against this membership before the move | The tier may be moved, under that review's reference |
| A review against this membership that is not approved | No tier move is authorised |
| An approved review recorded against a different membership | No tier move is authorised on this card |
| No review recorded against this membership at all | No tier move is authorised |

## How far a failed review drops the tier

Two hypothetical members illustrate the drop. Each holds a tier whose grace is 2 calendar months and whose soft landing is enabled, and each fails the review.

- The first fell one step short of the retention figure. At the end of the 2 grace months the tier drops one step.
- The second fell far enough short that the qualifying record earns a tier three steps below. Soft landing is enabled on the tier held, so at the end of the same 2 grace months the tier still drops only one step, however far short the member fell.

Where the tier held does not have soft landing, the drop is to the tier actually earned. In both cases the drop takes effect at the end of the grace months of the tier held, and the grace months are counted against the tier the member was holding when the review was failed, not against the tier the record earns.
